items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thu (2nd straight); day-to-day. Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) on IR. If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.implication: Lamar/Ravens pass game thinned; Bateman flex upside

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wed practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024); MRI pending; ran 37/42 routes W1. Schefter: doctors don't believe serious but Week 2 status in jeopardy; DNP Thu (Grade 1).
items.why: Hamstring strain practice + prior history; limited Wed then DNP Thu
items.implication: High-end WR2 risk; monitor Fri practice/MRI
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated routes/targets for Hutchinson (29), Boutte (27), Noel

items.text: Joe Burrow listed limited participant 2nd consecutive day due to back injury.
items.implication: Monitor for full/no designation; Bengals offense risk

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle, missed W1) full participant and says 'ready to go' for Week 2 vs Steelers.
items.why: Full practices + player confirmation via Reiss
items.implication: Splits with Stevenson; high-upside flex/RB2 with AJ Brown out

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 W1 (tied Bijan lead) under Kubiak. 19% tgt share recent; 25+ touches 3/4 last. Overreaction to prior ankle scare.

LOVE: Bucky Irving (26% tgt career-high, all RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell); DeVonta Smith (bounceback, 27% tgt/13.7 aDOT vs TEN soft); Justin Jefferson (37% tgt w/ Wentz history); Dalton Kincaid (69% routes career-high, 77% snaps).
items.implication: Start with confidence; Kincaid breakout signal

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) W1 with Chiefs; 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q, 74% snaps. RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy. vs IND (allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry).
A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain to IR (~4-6 weeks). ETR waiver beneficiaries: Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas.
items.implication: Patriots WR vacuum; Maye targets redistribute

items.text: W2 Waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman/Moore; A.J. Brown=Doubs/Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo/Robinson; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller (reverse if Kamara in); plus Deebo Samuel high priority.

HATE: Travis Etienne (Kamara return squeezes; air-dependent; underdog script @BAL); Marvin Harrison Jr. (8% tgt 5th on team, 0 RZ); Brian Thomas Jr. (@DEN tough perimeter + shoulder); Harold Fannin (14% tgt low, competition).
ETR Week 2 projections live (Purdy 2.5 pts clear top); ROS Top-150 updated with CMC/Etienne/Rice/Jeanty emphasis post-W1 usage/injuries.
Colston Loveland 89% route participation W1 (highest TE); only 2 tgts/0 pts but missed EZ looks. Buy if owner panics.
items.why: Elite route rate despite low volume/score

items.text: Kenyon Sadiq (16th pick, missed OTAs/camp hernia) debut: 28 snaps, schemed goal-line carry + screen + 2 other targets. Clear intent to get him ball despite limited practice.
items.implication: TE/RB hybrid stash upside; goal-line role

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week (Stribling injury context).
